plan.title: SRC-QCS-003 — Master QCS with two bids

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with two bids directly on its Master QCS screen.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case configuration.
Verify that both real bidding vendors appear as comparison columns.
Verify Vendor B has the best rank.
Verify Vendor A has the second rank.
Verify Vendor B's unit bid rate.
Verify Vendor A's unit bid rate.
Verify Vendor B's total for 10 units.
Verify Vendor A's total for 10 units.
Verify Vendor B's line amount and total arithmetic.
Verify Vendor A's line amount and total arithmetic.
Verify ranks follow the lowest total, with the lower bid ranked first.
